name: After straining his lower back while carrying things, his father guided him to begin rehabilitation stretching.

description: Continuing last month's exploration of old wine bottles, Lu Mingqiang, during the pre-Spring Festival cleaning (starting January 25, using weekends), sorted all more than 50 wine bottles by era. At the New Year's Eve dinner (January 28), he asked his father Lu Jianguo about the story of the Overseas Chinese farm. His father, a retired electrician, recalled his youthful experience participating in the farm's line renovation project, providing precious oral history. During the Spring Festival period (January 29 to February 4), Lu Mingqiang intermittently wrote a roughly 800-character "Wine Bottle Culture Notes" on his phone, recording the local stories behind three bottles, and completed an ISTJ-style systematic organization.

name: Completed the power distribution cabinet installation task at Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza

After the meal, the family exchanged gardening tips, and the eldest son asked questions curiously. The atmosphere was warm. name: After failing the theory section of the Senior Technician mock exam, he sought guidance from Master Li and received valuable handwritten notes and confidence.
description: On May 10, the results of the mock exam for the senior technician pre-exam intensive training course were announced. Lu Mingqiang scored only 58 in the theory section, far below the passing line. Feeling dejected, he went to his master, Master Li. Master Li not only lent him his handwritten book 200 Examples of Common Substation Fault Troubleshooting, but also advised him, "You are fine with the practical part; for theory, you need to go through it bit by bit to find and fill gaps, just like repairing a circuit." Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved and began that very night to re-plan his review schedule by chapters. This failure became the turning point in his May exam preparation sprint.

subevent.name: Mock exam theory results were released, and he failed.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 10, after taking a mock exam in the pre-exam intensive training class for senior technicians, Lu Mingqiang received a score report of 58 points for the theory section, below the passing line, and felt dejected.
subevent.location: Training classroom in Longhua District, Haikou City

subevent.name: Seek guidance from Master Li and obtain his handwritten notes.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 10, Lu Mingqiang went to his master, Master Li, because he failed a mock exam. At home, Master Li lent him his handwritten "200 Cases of Common Fault Troubleshooting in Substations" and encouraged him to identify and fill his gaps. Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved.
subevent.location: Master Li's home, Meilan District, Haikou

subevent.name: Replanned the theoretical review plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 10, after returning home, Lu Mingqiang, following Master Li's guidance and combining it with his notes, began to restructure his theory review plan by chapter, determined to make up for his weak points in the May sprint.
subevent.location: Home, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou.

name: After the physical examination, he started exercising and stuck with squash training
description: On March 11, the company physical exam report showed a BMI of 24.8, borderline overweight. The doctor advised losing weight. Lu Mingqiang remembered his lower back discomfort earlier in the year and resolved to run three times a week and have his wife supervise his diet. On March 12, on the squash activity day, Lin Feng suggested an internal mini-competition next month, so he practiced backhand moves more intently. On March 13, during his lunch break he walked briskly near the construction site, downloaded a running app to record data, and that evening started his first formal run at Wanlv Garden. On March 16, he did his second run. On March 19, after work he found the family car had been scratched. After paying 600 yuan out of pocket for repairs, he still insisted on going to the squash court to practice, putting health management above financial pressure.

name: Returned to hometown with his father to pay respects to ancestors during Qingming Festival, deepening family identity.
description: On the eve of Qingming Festival (April 3), Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan went to the market in Longhua District to buy sacrificial offerings. Early in the morning of April 4, he drove with his wife, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and younger son Lu Zihan, first to his father Lu Jianguo's home in Meilan District to meet up with his parents, then together they went to the ancestral house. At the ancestral house, the whole family placed offerings and bowed to pay respects to the ancestors; afterwards, his father recounted the hardships he experienced as an electrician in his youth. Lu Mingqiang inwardly compared it with his current life and felt a sense of inheritance. At noon, his mother and wife prepared a home-style lunch, and the whole family sat together to eat in a warm atmosphere. In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang's family tidied up, said goodbye to his parents, and returned to their home in Longhua District, sharing their feelings on the way. The whole ceremony deepened family identity and the bond between father and son.

subevent.location: Haikou City - Longhua District Market

subevent.name: Set off for the family home in Meilan District
subevent.description: On the morning of Qingming Festival, Lu Mingqiang drove the family car with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and second son Lu Zihan to his father's home on Haifu Road in Meilan District. They met up with his father Lu Jianguo and mother Chen Xiuying, and then all went together to the ancestral house.

subevent.name: Qingming ancestor worship ceremony.
subevent.description: After arriving at the ancestral house, Lu Mingqiang led the whole family in placing offerings, lighting incense and candles, and bowing deeply three times before the ancestral tablets to express their remembrance and respect for their ancestors. The whole process was solemn and dignified, and the children watched quietly from the side.

Lu Mingqiang silently compared his own current working conditions and felt a sense of heritage and connection to his father and family.

subevent.location: Haikou - home study

name: Bandaged a co-worker's wound on a typhoon night
description: On a typhoon night in July, during line inspection, fellow worker Jianguo's arm was cut by metal. Lu Mingqiang immediately used what he had learned in training to disinfect and bandage it, preventing infection.

subevent.name: Discovered that a co-worker was injured.
subevent.description: On a typhoon night, while Lu Mingqiang and his workmate Chen Jianguo were inspecting the power lines, Chen Jianguo's arm was cut by metal. Lu Mingqiang heard the noise and immediately went over to check the injury.
subevent.location: Power line maintenance site in Xiuying District, Haikou

subevent.name: Disinfected and bandaged a fellow worker's wound
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang used the first-aid kit he carried with him and, following the first-aid training steps he had learned, cleaned Chen Jianguo's wound, applied antiseptic, and bandaged it to prevent infection.
subevent.location: Power line maintenance site in Xiuying District, Haikou

subevent.name: Comfort and inspection after bandaging.
subevent.description: After the bandaging was done, Lu Mingqiang checked again to confirm the wound had no continued bleeding or serious infection risk, reassured Chen Jianguo, and suggested he temporarily stop working and rest in the car, while reporting to the squad leader.
subevent.location: Power line maintenance site in Xiuying District, Haikou

name: Flying kites at Wanlv Garden, meeting a friend and confiding, returning home to organize liquor bottle notes.
description: On Saturday, June 14, with educational anxiety and work pressure intertwined, Lu Mingqiang went alone to Wanlv Park to fly a kite and clear his mind. He skillfully manipulated the traditional kite, making it hover steadily at high altitude, and his mood gradually relaxed. He happened to meet his kite-flying friend Chen Jie; the two sat down on the grass while reeling in the line and briefly poured out their recent worries. After returning home, he took out his wine bottle collection notes, carefully wiped several old wine bottles, and said to himself, "These treasures need to be properly organized." He picked up the idea of cultural organizing again.

subevent.name: Flew a kite alone in Evergreen Park
subevent.description: In Wanlv Garden, Lu Mingqiang skillfully flew a traditional kite, keeping it circling steadily at high altitude. His mood gradually relaxed as he enjoyed a moment of peace.
subevent.location: Haikou - Evergreen Park

subevent.name: Ran into friend Chen Jie and confided his worries to him
subevent.description: While flying a kite, he happened to meet his kite-flying friend Chen Jie. The two sat down on the grass while reeling in their kites, and Lu Mingqiang briefly confided to Chen Jie about his recent parenting anxiety and work stress.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Evergreen Park lawn

subevent.name: Organized his wine bottle collection notes.
subevent.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang pulled out his bottle collection notes, carefully wiped several old wine bottles, and muttered to himself that he wanted to organize these treasures properly and rekindle his aspiration for cultural curation.
subevent.location: Haikou City - living room at home

name: Table tennis match debut
description: Lu Mingqiang came on as a substitute and played three games of doubles. Though he stopped in the first round, he regained the thrill of hitting from his youth. After the match, he exchanged WeChat contacts with three fellow players.

subevent.name: Pre-competition warm-up and preparation
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang arrived early at the table tennis hall of Haikou Workers' Cultural Palace as a substitute player, did some simple warm-up stretching, and briefly discussed doubles tactics with his temporary teammate.
subevent.location: Haikou Workers' Cultural Palace Table Tennis Hall

subevent.name: First round of doubles competition.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang teamed up with his partner for a three-game doubles match. They fought hard but ultimately stopped in the first round with a score of 1:2. During the match, he recaptured the thrill of hitting the ball from his youth.
subevent.location: Haikou Workers' Cultural Palace Table Tennis Hall

subevent.name: Post-match socializing and exchanging WeChat contacts.
subevent.description: After the match, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to exchange insights with three fellow players he had met on and off the court. They added each other as WeChat friends and agreed to play together again when the opportunity arises.
subevent.location: Haikou Workers' Cultural Palace Table Tennis Hall

name: Monthly family finance consolidation
description: On the evening of July 30, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan sorted out the family accounts at the dining table in the living room. Lu Mingqiang took out the ledger and checked July's income and expenses item by item: salary, part-time income, utility bills, children's interest class fees, supermarket shopping, and so on. The couple discussed the budget for the next month and decided to eat out less and cook more at home to save money. Lu Mingqiang noted the overspent transportation expenses as a reminder and planned to commute by electric bike next month.

subevent.name: Check July income
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang checked item by item whether his July salary of 40,000 yuan and part-time income of about 800 yuan had arrived. Wang Lijuan confirmed that her housekeeping part-time income of about 900 yuan had been credited, and the two recorded the total income in the ledger.
subevent.location: Haikou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Check July expenses item by item
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang checked the items in the notebook one by one, verifying water and electricity bills, supermarket food purchases, children's interest class fees, transportation costs, and eating-out expenses. Wang Lijuan added the scattered expenses that were missed, and the two found that transportation costs had exceeded the budget by about 200 yuan.
subevent.location: Haikou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Discussed next month's budget and savings plan.
subevent.description: Based on July expenses, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan discussed the August budget and decided to reduce the number of meals eaten out, cook more at home to save on groceries, and plan for Lu Mingqiang to commute by electric bike next month to reduce the transportation overspending. Lu Mingqiang recorded the overspent transportation costs on the reminder page of the ledger.
subevent.location: Haikou City - living room at home

name: Keep running, lose weight, post on Moments, and intensify squash training
description: Since mid-April he had persisted with morning running. On the morning of May 3, he weighed himself and found his weight had dropped by 1.5 kg. Lu Mingqiang excitedly took a photo and posted it on his Moments, receiving likes and encouragement from sports buddy Lin Feng, running buddy Chen Bin, and others. The successful weight loss greatly boosted his confidence, and the next day he decided to increase the frequency of squash training to further improve his fitness.

subevent.name: Weighed myself, found my weight had dropped, and took a photo to post on Moments.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 3, after completing his morning run, Lu Mingqiang weighed himself on an electronic scale at home and found that his weight had dropped 1.5 kg compared to three weeks ago. Excited, he took a photo of the scale with his phone and posted it on Moments with the caption 'Running really can lose weight!' He received likes and encouragement from sports buddy Lin Feng, running buddy Chen Bin, and others.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

subevent.name: Boost motivation for squash training.
subevent.description: The successful weight loss boosted Lu Mingqiang's confidence in health management. He decided to increase the number of weekly squash training sessions and adjust the training intensity to further improve his physical fitness and sports performance.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Power Fitness Club Squash Court

name: Declined his childhood friend's investment recommendation and sent tea to maintain their friendship
description: On July 9, his close friend Wang Hai recommended an online investment platform for electronic components on WeChat, claiming an annualized return of 15%. Lu Mingqiang was doubtful and did not respond immediately, deciding to consult a professional first. The next day (July 10), he called his brother Lu Minghua, who worked in the securities industry, and after receiving the reminder that "high returns mean high risks, and it's most likely a capital pool," he decisively refused Wang Hai. On the morning of July 11, he made a special trip to the post office to send two packs of Hainan Wuzhishan green tea, with a handwritten note: "Brother, tea clears the mind and money must be steady. I'll wait for you over old man's tea in Haikou." After receiving it, Wang Hai replied with a smiley emoji, and their friendship was not damaged by their difference of opinion.

subevent.name: Received an investment recommendation from a childhood friend.
subevent.description: His childhood friend Wang Hai recommended to Lu Mingqiang via WeChat an online investment platform for electronic components, claiming annualized returns of up to 15%. Although Lu Mingqiang was close to Wang Hai, he had doubts about this high-yield project and did not respond immediately, deciding to consult a professional first.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

subevent.name: Call my brother to consult about investment risks
subevent.description: After Lu Mingqiang had doubts, he immediately called his older brother Lu Minghua, who works in the securities industry, and described in detail the investment platform recommended by Wang Hai. Relying on his professional experience, Lu Minghua warned him that “high returns come with high risks, and it is most likely a Ponzi scheme,” and advised him to flatly refuse.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

subevent.name: Decisively rejected the investment recommendation.
subevent.description: After receiving his brother's reminder, Lu Mingqiang explicitly replied to Wang Hai via WeChat, telling him that he would not participate in the investment because the risk was too high and it did not conform to his financial philosophy. His tone was firm but calm, so as not to affect their childhood friendship.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

subevent.name: Sending green tea and handwritten notes to maintain friendship.
subevent.description: The next morning, Lu Mingqiang deliberately went to the post office near his home and mailed two packs of Hainan Wuzhishan green tea to his childhood friend Wang Hai in Shenzhen, along with a handwritten note: 'Brother, tea calms the mind; keep your money steady. I'll be waiting for you here in Haikou for laoba tea.' This was his way of expressing how much he valued their friendship and gently smoothing over the awkwardness caused by their differing views. When Wang Hai received it, he replied with a smiley emoji; their friendship was not affected.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Post Office

name: Got a squash membership card and did three weeks of intensive training, reaching the semifinals in a small club tournament.
description: On May 7, on the recommendation of his squash buddy Lin Feng, Lu Mingqiang paid 1,200 yuan for a six-month membership card at the squash club, and asked Lin Feng to coach his backhand technique. That evening he began the first week of special training. He then did the second and third weeks on May 14 and 21, and his backhand improved significantly. On the morning of May 24, he took part in a small internal club tournament and reached the semifinals thanks to his steady backhand and stamina. On May 25, excited after the match, he turned his training scorecard into a Programming Challenge Scorecard to motivate his eldest son Lu Zixuan.

subevent.name: Ask squash partner Lin Feng to coach backhand technique
subevent.description: At the squash club, asked fellow player Lin Feng to coach backhand stroke technique, recorded the key points, and made a breakdown training plan.
subevent.location: Haikou - Squash Club

subevent.name: Got a six-month membership card at the squash club.
subevent.description: On the recommendation of fellow squash player Lin Feng, he spent 1,200 yuan to get a six-month membership card at the squash club, regularly playing every Wednesday evening.
subevent.location: Haikou - Squash Club

subevent.name: Wednesday evening squash training (week 1)
subevent.description: First training session at the club with membership card, focusing on practicing the backhand moves coached by Lin Feng, and recording training notes.
subevent.location: Haikou - Squash Club

subevent.name: Wednesday evening squash special training (week 2)
subevent.description: Held another special training session to solidify backhand skills, and continued physical training.
subevent.location: Haikou - Squash Club

subevent.name: Wednesday evening squash training session (Week 3)
subevent.description: Final regular training before the competition, with match simulation and scrimmaging; backhand technique improved significantly.
subevent.location: Haikou - Squash Club

subevent.name: Participated in the club's internal small competition and reached the semifinals.
subevent.description: In the morning, took part in the club's internal competition and, with a steady backhand and solid stamina, won consecutive matches to make a historic run to the semifinals.
subevent.location: Haikou - Squash Club

subevent.name: After the match, he sorted things out and encouraged his eldest son.
subevent.description: After the competition, he excitedly transformed the training points chart into a “Programming Challenge Points Chart” to motivate his eldest son Lu Zixuan to study, and shared the joy of the match.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

name: After the emergency repair, Squad Leader Zhang treated everyone to a late-night snack
description: On the evening of July 16, after two days and two nights of emergency repairs, the crew members were exhausted. Squad Leader Zhang paid out of his own pocket to treat everyone to a late-night snack at a street-side food stall. Lu Mingqiang sat shoulder to shoulder with Jianguo, talking about the recent stress and back pain over beer and salt-and-pepper duck heads. Jianguo comforted him with his own experience: “That’s how our line of work is; just get through it.” They poured each other drinks, and their mood gradually relaxed amid teasing and understanding.

subevent.name: Wrap-up of emergency repair tasks and on-site cleanup
subevent.description: After completing two days and two nights of emergency power repair, the crew members cleaned up the site and inspected the equipment, preparing to wrap up.
subevent.location: Company site at No. 28 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City

subevent.name: Go to the food stall.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo either rode in Team Leader Zhang's car or walked to a familiar street-side food stall in Longhua District.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Longhua District street-side food stall

subevent.name: Midnight snack gathering and heart-to-heart talk
subevent.description: At a food stall, with beer and dishes such as salt-and-pepper duck jaws, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo sat side by side, pouring out their recent work stress and lower back pain. Jianguo comforted him with his own experiences. They poured each other drinks, and their mood relaxed amid banter.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Longhua District street-side food stall

subevent.name: Returned home after a late-night snack.
subevent.description: After the late-night snack, the team members each returned to their own homes to rest. Lu Mingqiang walked or cycled back to his home on Jinmao Middle Road.
subevent.location: No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou

name: A neighbor invited him, and he prepared to take part in the table tennis tournament.
description: On the evening of July 19, Uncle Wang, a neighbor, invited Lu Mingqiang in the hallway to join the sub-district staff table tennis competition. Persuaded, Lu Mingqiang asked for more details about the event, and the next day he went to the community cultural and sports center to sign up, then returned home to prepare his table tennis equipment.

subevent.name: Communicate competition details with Uncle Wang
subevent.description: After accepting the invitation in the hallway, Lu Mingqiang further asked Uncle Wang about the specific time, location, and rules of the community table tennis match.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Longhua District - Jinmao Middle Road residential building stairwell

subevent.name: Went to the community culture and sports center to register.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang went to the community cultural and sports center, filled out the registration form, and formally signed up for the subdistrict staff table tennis competition.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Longhua District - Community Cultural and Sports Center

subevent.name: Prepare table tennis competition equipment
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang dug out the table tennis paddles at home and checked their condition to make sure the equipment was complete.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Longhua District - Home

name: On Father's Day, took his family to see a wine bottle collection exhibition.
description: On June 14, on the recommendation of fellow collector Chen Jianguo, Lu Mingqiang sent five bottles from the old Hainan distillery and his cultural notes to the Haikou Mass Art Museum for exhibition. On June 15, Father's Day, he set out from home with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and second son Lu Zihan to visit the museum's "Hainan Folk Antiques Collection Exhibition." Seeing his bottles and the enlarged display of his cultural notes, his eldest son was surprised and praised him; his wife publicly affirmed the significance of his collecting for the first time. Lu Mingqiang felt deeply proud. After the exhibition, the whole family drove home and continued discussing the exhibition in the evening, sharing warm feelings.

subevent.name: Select and send liquor bottles to the exhibition.
subevent.description: Recommended by fellow collector Chen Jianguo, Lu Mingqiang submitted the five wine bottles from old Hainan distilleries in his collection, along with his organized cultural notes, to the Haikou Municipal Mass Art Center to confirm the exhibition details.
subevent.location: Haikou Mass Art Center

subevent.name: The family drove to the art museum.
subevent.description: On Father's Day, Lu Mingqiang, together with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and second son Lu Zihan, set out from their home on Jinmao Middle Road and drove to the Haikou Mass Art Museum to visit an exhibition.
subevent.location: Home, Jinmao Middle Road, Haikou City.

subevent.name: Visit the liquor bottle collection exhibition
subevent.description: The family visited the 'Hainan Folk Old Objects Collection Exhibition' at the Mass Art Museum. When they saw the liquor bottles he had submitted and his cultural notes displayed in enlarged form, his eldest son was surprised and praised him, and his wife publicly acknowledged the significance of his collection for the first time. Lu Mingqiang felt extremely proud.
subevent.location: Haikou Mass Art Center

subevent.name: Family conversation after returning home
subevent.description: After the exhibition, drove home. In the evening, the family continued discussing the exhibition and shared Father's collection achievements and warm feelings.
subevent.location: Home, Jinmao Middle Road, Haikou City.

name: Weekend Family Kite Flying
description: On the morning of July 19, after his back injury improved, Lu Mingqiang took his wife and two sons to Wanlv Garden to fly kites. The elder son excitedly tried to launch the kite himself, while the younger son chased after it. The family enjoyed their leisure time on the lawn by the sea. Lu Mingqiang competed with his sons to see whose kite flew higher, and laughter filled the air.

subevent.name: Prepare kite-flying gear and snacks
subevent.description: After getting up at 7 a.m., Lu Mingqiang took three traditional kites (including one spare) out of the storage room and checked whether the kite reels and frames were intact. His wife Wang Lijuan prepared a bag of Qingbuliang, mineral water, and several boxes of Laoba Tea snacks and put them in a backpack. The two sons excitedly helped carry the kites downstairs.
subevent.location: Home in Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

subevent.name: Kite-flying activity on the lawn at Evergreen Park
subevent.description: After arriving at the central lawn of Wanlv Garden at 9, Lu Mingqiang first demonstrated how to use the sea breeze to let out the kite line. His eldest son Lu Zixuan grabbed his own kite and tried to launch it independently; after two failures, he successfully got the kite into the air and shouted excitedly. His second son Lu Zihan ran around the lawn chasing seabirds with a small kite. Lu Mingqiang and his eldest son each flew a kite, competing to see whose could fly higher, while his wife took photos at the side. At about 10:30, Lu Mingqiang felt a slight soreness in his lower back, so he sat on the picnic mat to rest and watched his two sons continue to play.
subevent.location: Haikou, Hainan Province - Wanlv Garden Lawn

subevent.name: Gather your belongings and return home.
subevent.description: Around 11 o'clock, the wind weakened, and Lu Mingqiang called his sons to reel in the kites. The family packed up the kites and picnic mat, and his wife cleaned up the remaining trash. On the drive back, the two sons fell asleep in the back seat. Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife about next week's plans and arrived home at 11:30.
subevent.location: From Evergreen Park to home, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Purchased a Bluetooth speaker and began evening audio learning.
description: On the evening of August 15, Lu Mingqiang bought a Bluetooth speaker and hung it in the kitchen. In the evening, the listening content expanded from industrial history to parent-child education. His wife occasionally listened along, enriching the way they used fragmented time for learning.

subevent.name: Selected products online and placed an order.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang searched and compared Bluetooth speakers on an e-commerce platform, chose a waterproof speaker suitable for kitchen use, and placed an order.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

subevent.name: Receive and install the Bluetooth speaker.
subevent.description: In the evening, he received a package. After unboxing it, Lu Mingqiang hung the Bluetooth speaker on the kitchen wall and connected it to the power supply.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home Kitchen

subevent.name: First time listening to industrial history audio
subevent.description: After installation was complete, Lu Mingqiang turned on the speaker to play an audio about industrial history, using the fragmented time to study.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home Kitchen

subevent.name: Expand to parent-child education audio.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang switched the audio content to parent-child education. His wife Wang Lijuan was also attracted to come over and listen. The two listened and exchanged parenting topics.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home Kitchen

name: Participated in monthly safety training (high-temperature protection topic)
description: On June 25, Lu Mingqiang received a company notice about the next day's monthly safety training, with the theme of high-temperature operation protection. On the morning of June 26, he attended the training meeting and carefully listened to the content on high-temperature operation protection.

subevent.name: Receiving training notice
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang received a notification from an internal company notice or the team group chat that the monthly safety training would be held on the morning of June 26, with the theme of protection against high-temperature work and heatstroke first aid.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Home

subevent.name: Attended the monthly safety training meeting.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 26, Lu Mingqiang attended the monthly safety training led by the safety supervisor in the company meeting room, listening carefully to knowledge about working safely in high temperatures.
subevent.location: Haikou - Xiuying District - Meeting Room, Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd.

name: The notice for senior technician exam registration was issued, and the exam preparation plan was launched.
description: On August 15, Lu Mingqiang received the registration notice for the 2025 Senior Technician Examination at the company; the exam was scheduled for November. That same day, at home, he decided to increase his daily review time to 2 hours starting in September and to use weekends to tackle difficult theory problems. On August 16, based on the exam syllabus, he went to Xinhua Bookstore or ordered online the latest prep books and exercise sets, fully launching his exam preparation.

subevent.name: Received notification of senior technician exam registration
subevent.description: At the company, Lu Mingqiang received the officially issued 2025 Senior Technician exam registration notice, and learned that the exam is scheduled for November and about the registration requirements.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd. Office

subevent.name: Decided to intensify the review.
subevent.description: After carefully reading the notice, Lu Mingqiang immediately decided to increase his daily review time to 2 hours starting in September and to use all weekends to focus on tackling difficult theoretical problems.
subevent.location: Haikou City - home study room

subevent.name: Buy supplementary review materials
subevent.description: According to the annual exam syllabus, Lu Mingqiang went to Xinhua Bookstore or ordered online the latest senior technician theory study guides and exercise collections.
subevent.location: Haikou - Xinhua Bookstore / Online

name: Father and son prepare to participate in a science and technology model competition
description: On July 20, the eldest son Lu Zixuan came back from a community activity with the notice for the district science and technology model competition and excitedly showed it. Lu Mingqiang suggested making an eco-friendly powered car from waste materials. The father and son high-fived and decided to enter. On July 21, Lu Mingqiang completed the registration online. On July 22, the two went to a hardware store and a recycling station to buy materials. This process made Lu Mingqiang truly feel the positive feedback and hope brought by the change in his approach to education.

subevent.name: Eldest son showed the science and technology model competition notice.
subevent.description: Lu Zixuan returned from the summer community activity and excitedly showed his father Lu Mingqiang the flyer for the district science and technology model competition rules, and described the fun he had during the activity.
subevent.location: Longhua District, Haikou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Lu Mingqiang proposes an eco-friendly powered vehicle idea.
subevent.description: After Lu Mingqiang read the contest rules, he thought of using the motor from an old electric toothbrush at home and a used plastic bottle to make an eco-friendly powered car. He drew a preliminary sketch on the whiteboard and explained the working principle and the fun of making it to Zixuan.
subevent.location: Longhua District, Haikou City - home study

subevent.name: Father and son jointly decided to participate in the competition.
subevent.description: Lu Zixuan was very interested in the idea of an environmentally friendly powered car and kept asking for details. Lu Mingqiang seized the opportunity to encourage him to sign up for the competition together. They high-fived and officially decided to enter the district science and technology model contest.
subevent.location: Longhua District, Haikou City - living room at home

subevent.name: Register online for the science and technology model competition
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang used his mobile phone to log in to the district science museum competition registration system, filled in the basic information of the father and son according to the rules, uploaded an electronic photo of Zixuan's ID card, and completed the registration confirmation.
subevent.location: Longhua District, Haikou City - home study

subevent.name: Purchase materials for making an eco-friendly powered car.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang took Lu Zixuan to a hardware store and a waste electrical appliance recycling station near their home, where they bought and collected basic materials such as an old electric toothbrush, small motors, plastic bottles, waste cardboard, and glue, preparing to make an environmentally friendly powered car.
subevent.location: Hardware store on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou

name: Parent-child swimming class registration and course
description: To help the children learn to swim and improve their fitness, and also to follow the doctor's advice to use swimming's low-impact nature to aid his lower back recovery, Lu Mingqiang signed up the whole family for a summer parent-child swimming class at a swimming pool in Haikou. On the mornings of Sunday, July 27, 2025, and Sunday, August 2, he took his eldest and second sons into the water and followed the coach to learn breath holding, floating, and frog kick. Lu Mingqiang himself was also a non-swimmer. As he practiced movements while leaning on the pool edge, his sons joked that he looked like a frog, but he insisted on practicing carefully. After two lessons, he could float, and his lower back felt fine, which greatly boosted his confidence.

subevent.name: Registration and equipment preparation
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang signed up the whole family for a summer parent-child swimming class at a swimming pool on Longkun South Road in Haikou, and bought swimming trunks, goggles, swim caps and other gear for the three of them. He also communicated in advance with the coach about the children's and his own swimming foundations.
subevent.location: Haikou - Longkun South Road Swimming Pool

subevent.name: First swimming lesson
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang took his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, and his second son, Lu Zihan, to their first parent-child swimming class at the pool, where they followed the coach in learning breath-holding, floating, and frog kicks. As a non-swimmer, Lu Mingqiang lay on the pool edge practicing the movements; his sons teased him for looking like a frog, but he practiced earnestly and persisted. After class, he felt no discomfort in his lower back and gained much confidence.
subevent.location: Haikou - Longkun South Road Swimming Pool

subevent.name: After-class discussion and practice review
subevent.description: After class, Lu Mingqiang took his sons home to bathe and rest. At the dinner table, he shared interesting moments from the class with his wife Wang Lijuan and praised the boys' performance. As for himself, he decided to practice breath-holding more before the next class.
subevent.location: Home in Longhua District, Haikou City

subevent.name: Second swimming lesson
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang took his two sons to the swimming pool again for their second parent-child swimming lesson, continuing to consolidate breath-holding and floating techniques and learning the breaststroke kick. After a week of self-practice, he could already float without any lower-back discomfort, and his performance in class had improved significantly.
subevent.location: Haikou - Longkun South Road Swimming Pool

subevent.name: After-class summary and follow-up plan.
subevent.description: After the second class, Lu Mingqiang high-fived the children outside the swimming pool and called his father, Lu Jianguo, to share their progress in learning to swim. After returning home, following the coach's advice, he planned to arrange a family swimming practice once a week and considered signing up for additional courses.
subevent.location: Haikou - Longkun South Road Swimming Pool

name: Adjusting the daily schedule to ensure sleep quality during exam preparation.
description: To deal with sleep problems during the pre-exam intensive training for senior technician from April 14 to 25, Lu Mingqiang bought a foot soaking tub, lavender essential oil, and a relaxing light music album in advance on April 13. During the training, he soaked his feet for 15 minutes every night after returning home and listened to relaxing music to unwind, making sure to fall asleep before 23:00 and get at least 7 hours of sleep each day. At the same time, he gave up strong tea and coffee after the afternoon and switched to plain water or warm milk. At the end of the training, he evaluated the results and confirmed that he had developed a new sleep routine.

subevent.name: Buying bedtime relaxation products
subevent.description: On April 13, Lu Mingqiang bought a foot soaking tub, lavender essential oil, and a sleep-inducing light music album to prepare for adjusting his daily routine.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Supermarket

subevent.name: Adjusted afternoon beverage habit
subevent.description: To ensure sleep quality, Lu Mingqiang gave up strong tea and coffee after noon during the intensive training period, switching to plain water or warm milk.
subevent.location: Haikou City - home or workplace

subevent.name: First day of following the new beverage habit
subevent.description: In the afternoon at work, I consciously replaced my usual strong tea and coffee with newly bought warm milk or plain water, and reminded myself to stick with the adjustment to prepare for better sleep.
subevent.location: Haikou City - Workplace

subevent.name: Keep following the new drink habit
subevent.description: Every afternoon, insist on replacing strong tea and coffee with plain water or warm milk, gradually forming a new afternoon drinking habit, ensuring that the need to stay alert does not affect nighttime sleep

After discussing with his wife Wang Lijuan that evening, from June 14 onward he reduced the amount of rice at dinner, added more stir-fried vegetables and boiled chicken breast, and used home-grown chili peppers to make a dipping sauce. He also replaced his late-night snacking habit with a glass of warm water. This adjustment continued until June 30; at the end of the month his weight dropped slightly and the lower back discomfort eased.

subevent.location: Haikou, Hainan Province - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Develop the construction plan and bill of materials.

subevent.location: A supermarket warehouse in Longhua District, Haikou City

subevent.name: Executed the supermarket circuit upgrade construction.

subevent.description: At the supermarket worksite, Lu Mingqiang gathered the apprentices Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun for a brief pre-shift meeting. subevent.name: Installation of new galvanized cable trunking and cable trays.

name: Tutor the eldest son in math during the summer vacation
description: From early to mid-July, Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son in math at the dining table every evening. He used homemade cardboard 3D geometry models to visually explain area formulas. At first, his eldest son often got distracted or talked back. Remembering the idea from a lecture about seeing the child's effort, Lu Mingqiang forced himself to suppress his anger and instead listened patiently and gave concrete steps. Two weeks later, the parent-child relationship had clearly improved; his eldest son began asking questions on his own, and his resistance to studying had greatly decreased.

subevent.name: Preparing tutoring aids and materials
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang made solid geometry teaching aids (cube, cuboid, cylinder, etc.) from cardboard at home, and organized the knowledge points of elementary school math area formulas, preparing for the upcoming math tutoring for his eldest son.
subevent.location: Home in Longhua District, Haikou City

subevent.name: First math tutoring session (initial difficulties).
subevent.description: Over the course of a week, Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son in math at the dining table using homemade teaching aids, explaining area formulas. At first, Zixuan was distracted and talked back. Remembering the ideas from the lecture, Lu Mingqiang suppressed his anger, instead patiently listening and giving specific steps. By adjusting his approach, the father-son relationship gradually improved. Over the weekend, Zixuan completed a small test and got every answer right, and he voluntarily asked to continue the tutoring.
subevent.location: At home in Longhua District, Haikou City, by the dining table.

subevent.name: Start the first evening of tutoring on the area formula.
subevent.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang had his eldest son Zixuan sit at the dining table, took out homemade graph paper and cardboard models, and began explaining how to calculate the area of rectangles and squares. Zixuan was initially curious and fiddled with the teaching aids, but after a few minutes his attention began to wander and his eyes drifted toward the living room TV. Lu Mingqiang reminded him three times, his tone gradually becoming stern.
subevent.location: At home in Longhua District, Haikou City, by the dining table.

subevent.name: The next day, tutoring encountered a backtalk conflict.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang continued to tutor the area formula. Zixuan, frustrated by the heavy workload, burst out and talked back: 'I already understand everything the teacher says at school. I don't need you to teach me.' Lu Mingqiang felt his anger flare up instantly, but remembering the concept of 'understanding the child's emotions' from the lecture, he took a deep breath, sat down beside Zixuan, and asked Zixuan to first explain his own understanding. Then he pointed out the misunderstanding and helped him build the correct problem-solving steps.
subevent.location: At home in Longhua District, Haikou City, by the dining table.

subevent.name: Adjust methods and try to listen patiently.
subevent.description: Lu Mingqiang decided to change his strategy. Instead of explaining directly, he let Zixuan try an area problem first, then guided him step by step based on his mistakes. When Zixuan got stuck, Lu Mingqiang resisted interrupting and waited until he shared his thinking before adding anything. Zixuan sensed his father's change and gradually became willing to cooperate. That evening's tutoring session was extended by 15 minutes without any tantrums.
subevent.location: At home in Longhua District, Haikou City, by the dining table.

subevent.name: Mid-term tutoring establishes positive interaction.
subevent.description: After the adjustment of the past few days, Zixuan began to take out his textbooks and homework on his own, and after dinner he would sit at the dining table waiting for his father. Lu Mingqiang first used teaching aids to demonstrate the derivation of the area formula, then asked Zixuan to repeat it and do it himself. After Zixuan successfully calculated a problem independently, Lu Mingqiang praised him. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, and the parent-child cooperation was clearly in sync.
subevent.location: At home in Longhua District, Haikou City, by the dining table.

subevent.name: Summarize and consolidate the week's tutoring results
subevent.description: During the last tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang asked Zixuan to draw rectangles of different lengths and widths on a homemade teaching aid with a whiteboard marker and calculate their areas, as a quiz. Zixuan got them all right and happily showed his father. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to emphasize the practicality of math and encouraged him to keep it up. Zixuan nodded in agreement and even asked to continue tutoring the next week. Lu Mingqiang felt gratified, and the parent-child relationship had clearly improved.
subevent.location: At home in Longhua District, Haikou City, by the dining table.

subevent.name: Coaching summary and encouragement

description: On November 23, 2025, neighbor Uncle Wang came to ask for help because the air switch in his home kept tripping frequently. Lu Mingqiang took his tool bag and went to check. He found that the insulation layer of the old wiring was damaged, causing leakage and tripping. He then replaced the damaged wiring and reinforced the connections, and the circuit returned to normal half an hour later. Uncle Wang insisted on paying, but Lu Mingqiang politely declined and said that helping neighbors was only natural. Afterwards, Uncle Wang praised Lu Mingqiang in the community, which strengthened the neighborly relationship.

Wang Hai not only provided sales trends for smart locks and lighting controls in the Shenzhen market, but also proactively promised to help him keep an eye out for equipment supply channels, and encouraged him: "You have solid skills, you can definitely make it!" The two also talked about their respective family situations. Wang Hai said he would return to Haikou for the Spring Festival and they could meet in person then. This call made Lu Mingqiang's entrepreneurial blueprint clearer and made him feel the support of an old friend.

name: Resume physical exercise, annual physical examination, and formulate a new health plan.
description: On November 16, the day after the senior technician exam, Lu Mingqiang contacted his running partner Chen Bin for a morning run at Wanlv Garden, resuming the interrupted morning running habit. Chen Bin praised him for being faster than at the beginning of the year, and Lu Mingqiang attributed it to stretching and proper posture, and also picked up the fun of flying kites again. On November 22, he scheduled his annual physical examination for November 25. On the 25th, he went to the hospital to complete the formal checkup. On the 26th, he picked up the physical examination report; the doctor's interpretation showed he was basically healthy, weighing 71 kg with a BMI of 23.9, which was normal, but recommended keeping his weight below 70 kg. Lu Mingqiang immediately set a three-times-a-week running alarm on his phone and decided to adjust his diet starting in 2026, reducing greasy food.

description: On December 5, the results of the senior electrical technician exam were announced. Lu Mingqiang passed both the theory and practical sections and successfully obtained the certificate. He immediately notified his wife, Wang Lijuan, and his master, Master Li. His wife choked up on the phone and said that these months of hard work had not been in vain. At the pre-shift meeting that day, Squad Leader Zhang praised him publicly, and Manager Liu also sent congratulations via WeChat and promised to assign him more important work in the future. That evening, Lu Mingqiang invited his shift colleagues to celebrate at a grilled fish restaurant near the factory. His workmate Jianguo remarked during the meal that Lu Mingqiang was highly skilled, and everyone left in high spirits. This event marked an important milestone in Lu Mingqiang's career and laid the qualification foundation for setting up a personal studio later.

name: Held a retirement dinner for Master Li.
description: On December 11, 2025, Lu Mingqiang went to a seafood restaurant in Xiuying District, Haikou City, to book a private room for noon on December 13, and carefully framed an electrician tool collection box as a retirement gift. He notified team colleagues and fellow apprentices by phone and via the WeChat group. At noon on December 13, Lu Mingqiang gathered his team colleagues and fellow apprentices at the seafood restaurant in Xiuying District to hold a farewell banquet for Master Li, who was officially retiring. Speaking on behalf of the group, he expressed his gratitude and recalled how Master Li had taught him wiring hands-on when he joined in 2007. Choking up, he said, "Without Master Li, I, Lu Mingqiang, would not be where I am today," and gave him the framed electrician tool collection box. Master Li patted him on the shoulder and said words of encouragement. After the banquet, Lu Mingqiang sorted through the dinner photos at home, shared the on-site photos via WeChat with the fellow apprentices who could not attend, and sent Master Li a group photo from the dinner to express his gratitude.

On the 22nd, fellow collector Chen Jianguo introduced him to the WeChat group of the Haikou Local Liquor Bottle Collection Association, and thereafter evening exchanges in the group became a regular feature. On the 28th, Lu Mingqiang attended a year-end gathering of junior high school classmates, gathering with 8 people including Wu Gang, and chatting about midlife difficulties and the transformation of Haikou's old industrial areas. Because he had completed his certification, had stable finances, and had succeeded in tackling technical problems, he felt steady and decided to take his family to visit the old factory sites during the Spring Festival to collect more liquor bottle stories.

name: Troubleshoot the abnormal electricity bill and fix the neighbor's incorrectly connected wiring.
description: On December 12, Lu Mingqiang received an electricity bill of 600 yuan, more than double the usual amount. He checked his household appliances one by one and found nothing unusual. Relying on his electrician's intuition, he suspected the outdoor wiring. On the 13th, he finally discovered that a neighbor who had recently renovated the downstairs unit had mistakenly connected the air conditioner line to his family's shared meter. He calmly contacted the property management and the neighbor. After explaining clearly, the neighbor apologized on the spot, paid the extra electricity charges, and immediately hired an electrician to fix the wiring. To express his apology, the neighbor later sent a box of fruit. This incident demonstrated Lu Mingqiang's professional skills and his ability to properly handle neighborly relations.
